`A = Lib.Sub` is an ordinary dot reference, whose path selects declared members in its lexical owner, so `open A` provides the target's public `Q` to the front end and the evaluator alike. A written `open Lib.Sub` still selects public members only.
A written open path selects public members: a private step is refused, although a reference to the same member can be opened.
